svg.text: Four layers on the real Maple Bank data, one use case in depth (next best action). Runs with one command: docker compose up --build.
Sources: Maple Bank release, 31 tables from five customer-key systems
CRM, Cards, Lending, Core banking (CIF), Collections | contacts, promises, notes (760k), transcripts (25k), bureau, ops events, 19 policy documents
raw Parquet, one file per table,
dates in three formats, CIF zero padding,
steward review queue for the unsure
personal data, protected traits, marketing, writes, forecasts
25 metrics, breakdowns, filters, periods; SQL shown
picks a metric from a closed list; words policy
answers from quoted sections; offline by default
read-only, allowlist, role row filters, groups under 10 hidden
BM25, authority precedence, no citation means no answer
numbers + the SQL or sources + caveats, or a refusal
55 features with owner, source, refresh, version
contact, promise, bureau, salary, card, account history
hardship, dispute, complaint, delay reason from
one dbt macro, evaluated as of the promise
or as of now; parity check: 0 mismatches in 1,000
no protected attribute reaches a feature
consent, hours, Sundays, holidays, do-not-call, 7-day cap,
LightGBM + bank v2.1 blend, AUC 0.772 vs 0.694,
first match wins; priority = risk x capped amount - cost;
rules applied, model estimate, what changed, freshness, alternatives
agent approves, edits or overrides (reason needed);
team lead approves batches; specialist confirms hardship
plan simulator, review board, missed offers, override audit
lowered only by a person with a reason
outcome tests by group, review not drop
kept out of features, rules, prompts
and models; one auditor view reads them
